entries.title: Mark 11:1
segments: ¶Now when they drew near Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, He sent two of His disciples;

entries.title: Mark 11:2
segments: and He said to them, "Go into the village opposite you; and as soon as you have entered it you will find a colt tied, on which no one has sat. Loose it and bring [it].

entries.title: Mark 11:3
segments: "And if anyone says to you, 'Why are you doing this?' say, 'The Lord has need of it,' and immediately he will send it here."

entries.title: Mark 11:4
segments: So they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door outside on the street, and they loosed it.

entries.title: Mark 11:5
segments: But some of those who stood there said to them, "What are you doing, loosing the colt?"

entries.title: Mark 11:6
segments: And they spoke to them just as Jesus had commanded. So they let them go.

entries.title: Mark 11:7
segments: Then they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their clothes on it, and He sat on it.

entries.title: Mark 11:8
segments: And many spread their clothes on the road, and others cut down leafy branches from the trees and spread [them] on the road.

entries.title: Mark 11:9
segments: Then those who went before and those who followed cried out, saying: "Hosanna! 'Blessed [is] He who comes in the name of the LORD!'

entries.title: Mark 11:10
segments: Blessed [is] the kingdom of our father David That comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"

entries.title: Mark 11:11
segments: And Jesus went into Jerusalem and into the temple. So when He had looked around at all things, as the hour was already late, He went out to Bethany with the twelve.

entries.title: Mark 11:12
segments: ¶Now the next day, when they had come out from Bethany, He was hungry.

entries.title: Mark 11:13
segments: And seeing from afar a fig tree having leaves, He went to see if perhaps He would find something on it. When He came to it, He found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

entries.title: Mark 11:14
segments: In response Jesus said to it, "Let no one eat fruit from you ever again." And His disciples heard [it].

entries.title: Mark 11:15
segments: So they came to Jerusalem. Then Jesus went into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in the temple, and overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who sold doves.

entries.title: Mark 11:16
segments: And He would not allow anyone to carry wares through the temple.

entries.title: Mark 11:17
segments: Then He taught, saying to them, "Is it not written, 'My house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations'? But you have made it a 'den of thieves.'"

entries.title: Mark 11:18
segments: And the scribes and chief priests heard it and sought how they might destroy Him; for they feared Him, because all the people were astonished at His teaching.

entries.title: Mark 11:19
segments: When evening had come, He went out of the city.

entries.title: Mark 11:20
segments: Now in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

entries.title: Mark 11:21
segments: And Peter, remembering, said to Him, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree which You cursed has withered away."

entries.title: Mark 11:22
segments: So Jesus answered and said to them, "Have faith in God.

entries.title: Mark 11:23
segments: "For assuredly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, 'Be removed and be cast into the sea,' and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that those things he says will be done, he will have whatever he says.

entries.title: Mark 11:24
segments: "Therefore I say to you, whatever things you ask when you pray, believe that you receive [them], and you will have [them].

entries.title: Mark 11:25
segments: "And whenever you stand praying, if you have anything against anyone, forgive him, that your Father in heaven may also forgive you your trespasses.

entries.title: Mark 11:26
segments: "But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your trespasses."

entries.title: Mark 11:27
segments: ¶Then they came again to Jerusalem. And as He was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to Him.

entries.title: Mark 11:28
segments: And they said to Him, "By what authority are You doing these things? And who gave You this authority to do these things?"

entries.title: Mark 11:29
segments: But Jesus answered and said to them, "I also will ask you one question; then answer Me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things:

entries.title: Mark 11:30
segments: "The baptism of John--was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me."

entries.title: Mark 11:31
segments: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, 'From heaven,' He will say, 'Why then did you not believe him?'

entries.title: Mark 11:32
segments: "But if we say, 'From men' --they feared the people, for all counted John to have been a prophet indeed.

entries.title: Mark 11:33
segments: So they answered and said to Jesus, "We do not know." And Jesus answered and said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
